_comment: GLC-specific rule data beyond the format knobs. DECK-FORMATS §2.3. Rule-box classes drive both GLC's forbid_rule_box and the Std/Exp Radiant/Prism limits.
_rule_box_suffix_note: TCGdex 'suffix' covers these. VMAX/VSTAR/V-UNION/BREAK do NOT appear in suffix (DECK-FORMATS §7 item 9, confirmed against this DB: VMAX/BREAK have empty suffix, VSTAR carries 'V'); they are detected from the NAME instead (see rule_box_name_suffixes). Radiant and Prism Star are also name-detected. ACE SPEC comes from ace-spec.json.

_exclusive_groups_note: DECK-FORMATS §2.3.4 item 2. The FAQ explicitly closes the set ('these are the only cards affected'), so this will not grow silently. _not_tournament_legal_note: DECK-FORMATS §2.3.4 item 4 — illustrative, not exhaustive; no field marks these so it is hand-listed. Pre-BW anyway, so also excluded by the pool rule.
